tools.name: fax_status

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: send_fax · Private data: send_fax · Public sink: send_fax.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: send_fax · Private data: send_fax · Public sink: send_fax

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
